notes:
Fixed the aiming line being offset relative to desktop icons under high-DPI scaling.
Improved the manual ball-placement flow after the cue ball is potted and the restart flow; desktop icon restore on exit is more stable.
Update checks no longer wait a long time without network; failure does not affect the game.

history.notes:
First public release: desktop icons become billiard balls — aim with the mouse, hold to power up, release to strike.
Includes guide lines, cushion rebounds, clear-table timing and sink statistics; the original desktop icon layout is restored on exit.
Windows 10/11 x64 single-file executable, no Python installation required.
